what: iOS 27 navigation bar / toolbar glass item transitions, page push/pop, scroll edge effect, measured on device
probe: tool/ios_reference scene nav (Sources/Bars.swift, BarsRecorder: per display-link tick, every layer under the navigation bar, the floating toolbar and the scroll edge effect views), self-driven scripts PROBE_AUTO launched with devicectl; finger-driven captures (title-*, pop-edge-*, item-hold) recaptured with XCUITest synthesized touches (UITests/BarsUITests.swift, 30 Hz path points) on 2026-10-03 morning once UI automation was re-enabled

files.toolbar-swap.jsonl: setToolbarItems(_:animated:) A -> B -> A -> C -> A (A = [Filter] | [compose], B = [trash folder] | [reply compose], C = [trash] [folder] | [compose]); rows: evt (the call), B with cls SDFElement (one CASDFElementLayer per glass capsule, window-space center x/y and size), UIImageView / UIButtonLabel (item content)
files.push-pop.jsonl: pushViewController / popViewController(animated: true) from a large-title list to a detail screen; cls page = the scroll edge backdrop views of each page (lid 1 = the list page, lid 88 = the detail page; their x is the page center), SDFElement = nav bar capsules, label = bar labels, fade = item content views with alpha + blur
files.scroll-edge.json: distinct layer states of UIKit.ScrollEdgeEffectView (automatic/soft/hard, light/dark)
files.title-drag-collapse.jsonl, title-fling.j: a slow 200 pt drag up and back down; a 250 pt flick up. Rows: so (contentOffset oy, adjusted inset it, tracking tr / decelerating dec), touch, B cls title (_UINavigationBarHostedViewWrapper alpha a + blur) and edge (UIKit.ScrollEdgeEffectView alpha)
files.title-drag-partialN.jsonl: drags of N pt released with the large title partly under the bar (10 pt slop: scrolled N - 10); 20/24/28/31/35 snap back out, 40/45 snap fully under
files.pop-edge-*.jsonl: push, then an interactive edge swipe trimmed to the swipe (0.05 s before the touch .. 0.8 s after the lift); cls page = the scroll edge backdrop views of each page (the page center x). commit / cancel: to 277 pt held, to 140 and back to 40; slowN: to N percent of the width over 1 s, held 0.4 s (25 and 30 return, 35 pops); flick-v400 / -v450: 80 / 90 pt in 0.2 s released moving (return / pop); flickback: to 260, back to 200 in 0.1 s (pops), flickback3: back to 170 in 0.1 s (returns)
files.item-hold.jsonl: a 0.8 s press on the trailing bar button group (99.33 x 44 capsule); cls capsule = its CASDFElementLayer frame
files.pop-edge-drift-*.jsonl: interactive edge swipes recaptured 2026-10-03 (morning, 10:16) with the navigation bar capsules kept: cls capsule = the CASDFElementLayer frames of the bar's glass capsules (duplicated per layer copy; the corner-radius filter of the export drops rows while a capsule swells, so the post-commit item transition is incomplete), cls page = the page centers as in pop-edge-*. commit: to 280 pt held, released (pops); cancel: to 140 and back to 40 (returns); slow25 / slow40: to 25 / 40 percent of the width over 1 s, held 0.4 s (returns / pops). Detail bar: back 94 wide at the leading edge, Done-like 73.67 outermost trailing, 103.67 inner; list bar: 62.33 leading, 99.33 trailing. During the drag each capsule the list bar also has drifts 0.49 (lag 0) .. 0.50 (1-2 ticks lag) x the page's progress toward its list layout, 0.28 pt rms
files.navsegb-push-pop.jsonl: navseg scene set b (PROBE_SET=b, PROBE_ROOTSCROLL=200), 2026-10-05: push x4 / pop x4 over [1x]; back [plus more] [1x]; back [Show Preferences]; back [heart] [Show Preferences]; back [heart bookmark] [share] [overflow]. Rows k=B cls SDFElement (bar nav/tool, host 0/1 = SwiftUI SDF layer, lid = element identity) and cls group (in-place group container: sx, sy, a, blur); evt push/pop with from/to
files.navsegb-toolbar.jsonl: navseg set b root toolbar: setToolbarItems E, D, F, G, F, D (D [compose], E [reply share folder] [compose], F [Show Preferences], G [heart] [Show Preferences]); rows as navsegb-push-pop
files.navsegb-toolbar2.jsonl: navseg set b root toolbar: H, D, F, I, F, D, J, D (H [heart] [compose], I [reply share folder] [Show Preferences], J [reply share folder] [heart]); rows as navsegb-push-pop

units: points (pt), window coordinates, seconds on the device media clock
